name: The Beverly Hills Hotel
insider_take: The legendary "Pink Palace" where Hollywood royalty has retreated since 1912, wrapped in 12 acres of tropical gardens on Sunset Boulevard.
whats_special: This iconic salmon-pink hotel is home to the famous Polo Lounge where power deals are sealed over McCarthy Salads, and the legendary poolside Cabana Club where Marilyn Monroe, Elizabeth Taylor, and countless A-listers have lounged. The hotel's signature banana leaf wallpaper in the Beverly Hills Hotel Restaurant has become as famous as its celebrity guests.
pro_tip: Request a poolside cabana for the ultimate Beverly Hills experience – these private retreats come with dedicated service and are where the real Hollywood networking happens.
dont_miss: The Crystal Ballroom's stunning hand-painted ceiling, afternoon tea service overlooking the gardens, and a sunset cocktail at the rooftop area. Take a stroll through the lush grounds to spot the hotel's resident peacocks that have called this place home for decades.
pros: Iconic pink palace with legendary Hollywood glamour and heritage
Prime location on Sunset Boulevard in prestigious Beverly Hills
Exclusive Diamond Club Program benefits and privileges
World-class spa and luxury amenities throughout the property
cons: Ultra-luxury pricing reflects exclusive Beverly Hills location
High-profile location may attract paparazzi and crowds
